author: Jerry Puffer
title: High School Seniors Can Enter $500 Scholarship Drawing At Marias River Electric Cooperative Wednesday - NewsBreak
text:
By Jerry Puffer ,
21 hours ago
This Wednesday evening’s the Annual Meeting of Members of Marias River Electric Cooperative. The presentation will begin at 6, with registration of membership, and a FREE buffet dinner served up by our local 4-H clubs. The business meeting will be at 7. The annual meeting, besides a lot of fun and fellowship with your neighbors and friends, is for the purpose of electing trustees, reports of officers, auditor and manager and all other business that may properly come before the meeting. And dig this! High school seniors can enter at registration time for a chance to WIN a $500 scholarship to be drawn during Wednesday evening’s business meeting. Don’t worry about a thing, but a parent/guardian MUST be a member of the cooperative to enter. You also MUST be present to WIN the door prizes too. All in all, I submit this Wednesday’s annual meeting of Marias River Electric Cooperative members should be an “electrifying” experience!
